aboutHtml:
We're a family-owned STIHL SHOP in Drury, operating since 2004. We built on a long history with the STIHL brand and the expertise of Jim Downs, the original owner and renowned STIHL specialist. Over the years, we've become part of the local community, helping Drury residents look after their properties and land.

We stock a wide range of outdoor power equipment from top brands: STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Polaris, Hansa Chippers, Honda, and Ziegler & Brown. Whether you need a new machine, parts, servicing, or advice on what's right for your situation, we're here to help. We've also made it easier to shop with us online through Home Delivery and Click & Collect options.

Come and see us in Drury. You'll find a team that knows equipment and cares about supporting local people, schools, and community groups in the district.
